wave_boundary.rule: All timestamped Ghidra jobs from the first explicit Wave 2 job through the final retained job in the pool at census time; the junction is not counted twice.

invalidation.reason: Jobs were dispatched while the pool exposed 20 shards; promotion authority requires exactly 10 shards.

execution_contract.target_assignment: Advisory round-robin plan across shard-01 through shard-10; the broker owns actual scheduling.
execution_contract.success_rule: Each action must emit a new broker receipt whose actual job ID, actual shard, exact semantic request hash, identity contract, pool-status receipt, and artifact hashes satisfy required_identity_gate.
execution_contract.failure_rule: Fail closed on identity mismatch, shard-count mismatch, non-ready shard, analysis enabled, serialization violation, persistent error, missing artifact, or artifact hash failure.
execution_contract.promotion_join: Replace every source_job_id citation with the actual broker receipt job/artifact mapping while retaining source_job_ids as provenance aliases. Never promote from planned target_shard_id.
execution_contract.receipt_authority: The returned job.json/result record: actual job_id, actual result.shard.id (or job shard.id), exact request hash, identity manifest hash, artifact path/hash, plus the exact-10 pool status receipt. Planned target_shard_id is never authoritative.

semantic_request_hash_contract.serialization: compact JSON with fixed top-level key order operation,request; label omitted; request key order is terms for search_strings, addresses for dump_data, and addresses,depth,pcode for export_functions; array order preserved
semantic_request_hash_contract.purpose: Exact request identity, not artifact identity.

execution_contract.canonical_replay_immutability: The 122 canonical actions remain byte-for-byte semantic replays of the discovery requests. Dossier-required exact function entries that were only transitive children are tracked solely as separately hashed supplemental_exact10_actions.
